case_reference.focal_claim: There was a decline in the temperature-mortality relationship across decades.
case_reference.hypothesis: The association between extreme temperature and mortality is smaller in later decades (e.g., 1960–2004) than in earlier decades (e.g., 1931–1959).

tasks_info.task_instruction: Conduct the analysis without any restrictions.

Use 90 °F as a threshold for temperature extremes. Compute the decline between the 1931–59 and 1960–2004 periods. Conduct the analysis without geographical, or precipitation frequency specification of the data. Use a 2 months temperature exposure window in the analysis. Disregard socio-economic factors and technological and public health advancements over time in the analysis. Do not specify the causes of death in the analysis.

description.path_summary: Reanalysis tests whether the temperature-mortality relationship declined across decades by modeling log mortality rate on temperature-bin exposures with decade indicators and interactions. Task1 mirrors the original structure with full controls and multiple decade specifications. Task2 focuses on 90°F threshold and compares 1931–59 vs 1960–2004 with reduced controls per instruction.

path_signature.main_predictor: Temperature exposure bins b10_1–b10_10; for Task2, b10_10 as >90°F extreme-heat exposure; interactions with decade indicators (decade_two and decade)
controls: Population shares by age (sh_0000, sh_0144, sh_4564, sh_6599) and their interactions with month
lri and its interaction with month (Task1 only, excluded in Task2 per instruction)
path_signature.sample_restriction: Drop rows with missing lndrate; restrict to years >= 1931; compare pre-1960 vs post-1959 using decade_two for Task2.
path_signature.variable_construction: Compute statemo = stfips*1000 + month; yearmo = year*1000 + month; year2 = year^2; b10_b_4 = b10_1 + b10_2 + b10_3 + b10_4; decade (11 levels by decade); decade_two (1=year<=1959, 2=year>1959).
path_signature.inference_rule: Sign and statistical significance of interaction terms between temperature exposures (especially b10_10) and decade indicators (decade_two or decade) to assess decline in effect over time.

planned_method.environment: Base R with packages: foreign, dplyr, ggplot2, tidyr.

models: M1: lndrate ~ b10_1 + b10_2 + b10_3 + b10_4 + b10_5 + b10_6 + b10_8 + b10_9 + b10_10 + (sh_0000 + sh_0144 + sh_4564 + sh_6599)*month + lri*month + statemo + yearmo + year2 + devp25 + devp75.
M2: Same as M1 plus interactions with factor(decade_two) for all temperature bins.
M3: Same as M1 plus interactions with factor(decade) for all temperature bins.
M4: lndrate ~ (b10_9 + b10_10 + b10_b_4)*factor(decade_two) + same controls as M1.
M5: lndrate ~ (b10_9 + b10_10 + b10_b_4)*factor(decade) + same controls as M1.
Task1.focus_parameters: Interaction terms of b10_10 with decade_two and with decade; optionally b10_b_4 for cold extremes.

Task2.constraints: Use 90°F threshold; compare 1931–59 vs 1960–2004; no geographic or precipitation frequency specification; 2-month temperature exposure window; disregard socio-economic and technology/public health advancements; do not specify causes of death.
Task2.model: M1: lndrate ~ b10_10 * factor(decade_two) + (sh_0000 + sh_0144 + sh_4564 + sh_6599)*month + yearmo + year2.
Task2.excluded_controls: Socioeconomic, geographical, and precipitation controls excluded per instruction.

description.method_justification: Interacting temperature exposure variables with decade indicators directly tests whether the strength of the temperature-mortality association changed over time. Using b10_10 (>90°F) isolates extreme heat exposure for Task2 as required. The outcome lndrate and temperature bins (b10_1–b10_10) are available in the authorized dataset. Fixed effects proxies and time trends align with the original study structure. Sign and size of interaction coefficients indicate whether mortality sensitivity to temperature declined in later decades.

codebase.notes: Scripts read DATA_1900_2004.dta directly and implement the models described in the review PDF.

self_check.data_availability: DATA_1900_2004.dta and DATA_TABLE9.dta are present. Variables lndrate, b10_1–b10_10, sh_*, lri, devp25, devp75, stfips, year, month exist.
self_check.constructs_check: decade_two and decade can be computed from year; statemo/yearmo/year2 can be computed from stfips, year, month; b10_b_4 as sum of b10_1..b10_4.
self_check.task2_constraints_applied: Only b10_10*decade_two interaction used; socioeconomic/geographical/precipitation controls excluded; compare pre-1959 vs post-1959; restrict to years >= 1931.
self_check.inference: Primary test is whether the interaction term(s) for b10_10 with later decades are negative and significant, indicating decline over time.

required_checks.same_focal_claim: The proposed path must test the same focal claim.
required_checks.same_dataset: The proposed path must use the authorized original dataset.
required_checks.not_duplicate: The proposed path must not repeat any path in shared_memory.
required_checks.task_completeness: The proposed path must specify both Task1 and Task2.
required_checks.method_justification: The proposed path must explain why the model, variables, and inference rule can test the claim.
required_checks.executable_in_principle: The proposed path must be clear enough to execute and must use variables that are available or clearly constructible.

allowed_actions: Accept or reject the candidate path.
not_allowed_actions: Do not modify the proposed path.
Do not change the focal claim.
Do not create a new analysis path.
